target.project: ganga (Ganga 8.4.2, CERN LHC workload management framework)
target.projectDescription: Ganga 8.4.2 (setup.py _gangaVersion '8.4.2', packaged with find_packages('./') -> the whole ganga/ tree: GangaCore + GangaGUI + GangaService + ~15 experiment plugins GangaAtlas/GangaLHCb/GangaDirac/...). It is a CLI/interactive job-orchestration tool (python bin/ganga, optparse bootstrap in GangaCore/Runtime/bootstrap.py) with two additional service surfaces: (1) GangaGUI - a Flask web GUI (gui/routes.py, ~90 @gui.route registrations on the `gui` Flask app served by gunicorn) plus a companion 'internal' Flask app (api/routes.py, ~40 @internal.route registrations) that exposes the full Ganga GPI namespace (jobs, config, export, load, runfile) over HTTP and is started on a GangaThread bound to localhost (GangaGUI/start.py:32/:106, free port); the GUI server communicates with it via query_internal_api (gui/routes.py:1804). (2) GangaService - a legacy py2-era socket service (GangaService/Lib/ServiceAPI/ServiceAPI.py, pickle over sockets; fixed ~/gangadir-server paths). Path-traversal-relevant architecture: THE untrusted file-access channels are the two GUI route-path file browsers and the internal-API path parameters: (a) /job/<int:job_id>/browse/<path:path> (gui/routes.py:636-:637, handler job_browse :639) joins the request path onto the job base directory with abs_path = os.path.join(job_base_dir, path) at :659 (os.path.join keeps '..' lexically; an ABSOLUTE path value REPLACES the base), then os.path.exists :665, os.path.isfile :670 and send_file(abs_path) :671 / os.listdir(abs_path) :676 - no resolve/realpath, no '..' rejection, no base-dir containment check anywhere in the flow (job_base_dir itself derives from job_info['outputdir'] returned by the internal API at :651). (b) /storage/<path:path> (gui/routes.py:922-:923, handler storage_page :925) joins the request path onto gui.config['STORAGE_FOLDER'] at :934 with the same unchecked os.path.join and serves send_file :975 / os.listdir :980; its POST upload branch takes request.files['storagefile'] :941, sanitizes ONLY the uploaded FILENAME with werkzeug secure_filename at :953, then saves to os.path.join(abs_path, filename) :954 with storagefile.save(save_path) :955 - the DIRECTORY part (abs_path, from the route path) is NOT sanitized, so the upload write destination escapes gangadir/storage via '..' or absolute paths (CWE-22 write channel; secure_filename is a partial sanitizer that does not cover the path component). (c) the internal API (NO authentication on any route, localhost-bound): /internal/jobs/<job_id>/export (api/routes.py:212-:227) takes save_path = request.args.get('path') at :223 and calls the GPI export(jobs(job_id), save_path) which writes the object dump via stripped_export -> fullpath (os.path.abspath(expandvars(expanduser(...))) at GangaCore/GPIDev/Persistency/__init__.py:149-:150 - abspath normalizes '..' AFTER the join but does not confine to any base) -> open(filepath, mode) at :85 - arbitrary file WRITE from an unauthenticated local HTTP request; /internal/load (api/routes.py:966-:984) takes path = request.args.get('path') :977 -> GPI load(path) -> getScriptPath search -> open(filepath) Persistency/__init__.py:190 - arbitrary file READ; /internal/runfile (api/routes.py:989-:1005) takes path :1001 -> runfile(path) -> runpy.run_path (GangaCore/Runtime/GPIFunctions.py:115 - Pass 4 code execution, recorded as adjacent). (d) fixed-path GUI file writes that carry attacker CONTENT: runfile_page open(UPLOAD_FOLDER/runfile.py, 'w+') gui/routes.py:375 with request.form.get('runfile-data') :374 (content then executed via /internal/runfile), job_edit open(loadfile_path, 'w+') :606 with request.form.get('edited-job-info') :604, config_edit open(gui_rc, 'w') :273 with request.form['config-data'] :272 (gangarc config rewrite - content injection, Pass 4/5 adjacent). (e) CLI/env channels (operator trust): optparse --config/--config-path (bootstrap.py:269-:273) -> expandfilename -> open (bootstrap.py:341-:345); GANGA_CONFIG_FILE os.environ.get bootstrap.py:336 / Utility/Config/__init__.py:52; GANGA_CONFIG_PATH os.environ['...'] bootstrap.py:673; the positional script argument self.args[0] -> getScriptPath -> open(script).read() + exec at bootstrap.py:1080-:1097; os.getenv reads (scratch dirs, X509 proxy paths) across GangaCore/GangaDirac. (f) archive extraction (backend-supplied tarballs): GangaCore/Core/Sandbox/Sandbox.py:154 tf.extractall(dest_dir, [tarinfo]) (job output sandbox unpacked at job completion) and WNSandbox.py:71 tf.extractall(dest_dir) (input sandbox unpack at runtime), plus plugin extractall sites (GangaLHCb GaudiExecMerger.py:226, GangaSAGA SAGAWrapperScript.py:87 bare extractall() to cwd, GangaSNOplus job_tools.py:310/:322). Flask, werkzeug, flask_socketio and runpy are external libraries not present in this CodeQL database (the 119442-LOC baseline covers the ganga repo only).

toolchain.compatibilityBasis: API facts used by the generated queries reuse only structural shapes already proven by the queries of this series that RAN on this same CLI + pack family (aiohttp, airflow ran both sources and sinks; ansible ran sources; coderedcms/copyparty/dfetch/django/fides generated with the same contract): AstNode.getLocation().getFile(): File and Location.getStartLine() (Location API - AstNode.getFile() does not exist), AstNode.getScope() and Scope.getEnclosingModule() (semmle/python/AstExtended.qll), Module.getName() and Module.getFile().getShortName() (semmle/python/Module.qll), Call.getFunc()/getArg(int)/getAnArg() (semmle/python/Exprs.qll, getArg(int) verified present at Exprs.qll:156 of the local python-all 7.1.2 pack), Attribute.getName()/getObject(), Subscript.getObject(), Function.getName()/getAnArg()/getEnclosingScope() (semmle/python/Function.qll - getAnArg() covers positional parameters including self), Parameter.isSelf()/getPosition()/getName() (semmle/python/Function.qll, Parameter.getPosition at Function.qll:280), Class.getName() (semmle/python/Class.qll). The two queries define no QL classes (only predicates), never assign API::Node values to DataFlow::Node variables, keep every variable bound through a positive body, keep resolved-API matching out entirely (all families are AST syntax matches; the match_kind column is kept 'ast' for cross-project contract consistency), name the module-path variable moduleHint (never `module`), and leave no {{...}} template placeholders. Deprecations avoided: no StrConst, no Decorator class, no AstNode.getFile(), no unbound `this`. CodeQL execution itself is deferred to the next round per the task contract.

scoring.result: Flask detected as primary framework (confidence 1.0) for the GangaGUI web surface (the only HTTP attack surface of the codebase), with flask_login/flask_sqlalchemy/flask_socketio as GUI sub-frameworks (0.8) and optparse as the operator-trust CLI parser (0.75). references/flask.md was loaded per WORKFLOW.md 4.2.3 and cross-checked against the actual code: its source signatures (request.args/form/json, path variables in route handlers, headers) all match observed shapes (the two <path:path> browsers, request.args.get('path') of the internal API, request.form.get writes, request.headers['X-Access-Token']); its high-value sink list (filesystem APIs with request-derived path, open + path join) maps exactly to the send_file/os.path.join/open families below; its sanitizer guidance (normalize path + enforce base-dir checks) is ABSENT in the two browser flows (only secure_filename on the uploaded filename, never on the directory component); its Pass-1 reminder (file upload/download endpoints dominate risk) matches the storage upload/download route. The internal Flask app is NOT blueprint-based (flask.md section 7) - it is a second Flask instance, and its lack of auth is recorded as contextual evidence, not as a source property.

inputBoundaryInventory.summary: ganga is an interactive/CLI tool with a Flask web GUI; the untrusted-input boundaries are: (1) the GUI route-path variables - /job/<int:job_id>/browse/<path:path> injects the entire request path (Flask path converter, post-URL-decode, '/' allowed) into job_browse as the `path` parameter (gui/routes.py:637/:639), which is joined onto the job base dir at :659 and reaches exists/isfile/send_file/listdir; /storage/<path:path> injects it into storage_page (:923/:925) joined onto the storage folder at :934, reaching isdir/exists/isfile/send_file/listdir and (via the POST upload branch) the save destination join at :954; (2) the internal-API query parameters - request.args.get('path') of /internal/jobs/<job_id>/export (api/routes.py:223, flows into the GPI export WRITE), of /internal/load (:977, GPI load READ) and of /internal/runfile (:1001, runpy EXECUTION - Pass 4); plus ~50 further request.args.get filter parameters (status/application/backend/length/offset/ids) that do not reach filesystem paths; (3) GUI form fields - request.form.get('runfile-data') :374 / ('edited-job-info') :604 / ['config-data'] :272 (content written into fixed server paths then executed/loaded); (4) GUI multipart uploads - request.files['storagefile']/:941, ['loadfile']/:294, ['runfile']/:320 with .filename reads (extension-checked by allowed_file :1799-:1800, name-sanitized by secure_filename :953 - but the save DIRECTORY from the route path is unsanitized); (5) request.json body reads of the two create endpoints (api/routes.py:86/:139, gui/routes.py:1048/:1188); (6) request.headers['X-Access-Token'] (gui/routes.py:1084 - token auth material); (7) environment variables (GANGA_CONFIG_FILE, GANGA_CONFIG_PATH, X509_USER_PROXY, EDG_WL_SCRATCH, TMPDIR, KRB5CCNAME, ...) - operator trust level; (8) the optparse CLI (--config/--config-path, positional script argument) - operator trust level; (9) backend-supplied job sandbox tarballs (extractall at job completion / at runtime). The sink side funnels through: send_file (the actual GUI file serve), the os.path.join of the two browsers, werkzeug FileStorage.save, builtin open() (~430 sites across the tree), os.open (repository session locks), os.makedirs/mkdir, os.remove/unlink/rmdir, os.rename, shutil copy/move/rmtree/copytree, os.listdir/os.walk, os.symlink, os.chmod, tarfile.open + .extractall (6 sites), glob.glob, secure_filename (partial sanitizer), and the internal path-taking wrapper definitions (export/stripped_export/fullpath/load, runfile, getScriptPath, expandfilename, fullpath, getPackedOutputSandbox/getPackedInputSandbox/recursive_copy/createOutputSandbox/createPackedOutputSandbox, FileWorkspace.getPath, allowed_file).
